detected_fault: Random system reboots, freezes, Wi-Fi disconnects, and device manager freezes.
suggested_solution: Roll back MediaTek MT7927 Wi-Fi 7 driver to version 25.20.3.52
Disable Windows driver updates and only update from Lenovo
Set link state power management options to off in Power Plan settings
Check and adjust '802.11be/ax/ac/n/abg' property value in Device Manager properties
